brief_data.deck: Infineon, the world's number one power-semiconductor maker, raised guidance on 6 May 2026 as AI data-centre demand surged, then on 8 June put its silicon carbide into Siemens' circuit breakers. Formula E's 600 kW GEN4 car debuts in December; the one team that has run a power-semiconductor partner has none.

risks.label: ROAD-CAR SUPPLIER TENSION
risks.detail: JLR contracted its road-car silicon carbide to Wolfspeed in 2022, and Infineon buys wafers from Wolfspeed.
risks.counter: Position Infineon as the GEN4 racing partner, separate from road-car supply; the wafer link makes it familiar, not a rival.

risks.label: NO SPORT SINCE 2012
risks.detail: Infineon has not bought a sports property since the raceway naming rights lapsed; appetite is unproven.
risks.counter: Anchor on the engineering workstream and the CMO's board mandate; a component-level deal is cheaper than a circuit name.

extended.ask: A 25-minute call with Andreas Urschitz before the London E-Prix to size an Official Power Semiconductor Partner entry for Seasons 13-15, scope the GEN4 inverter workstream with Jaguar's engineers, and settle the road-car supplier question up front.

value.text: CoolSiC silicon-carbide power modules and gate drivers for the GEN4 traction inverters, where switching losses and thermal headroom decide how much of 600 kW reaches the tyres and how much of 700 kW regeneration comes back; application engineering on inverter topology and cooling; silicon carbide for the team's charging and pit-garage power equipment. Infineon's HybridPACK Drive family already runs on more than 20 EV platforms.
value.label: Operational workstream (Mode A)

value.text: A partner that sells to every carmaker and every hyperscaler brings an automotive and data-centre guest list to Austin, Miami and Berlin, and a component-level technical partnership that TCS and Castrol can build joint content around.
value.label: Commercial lift for the team

value.text: The inverter is Formula E's least visible and most important component. An engineering series from the dyno to the E-Prix, with Jaguar's power-electronics engineers, gives Infineon the visible story behind 'the power behind electrification' and gives the team technical content its title partner can amplify.
value.label: Content and ecosystem

value.text: Official Power Semiconductor Partner designation, halo and rear-wing placement, hospitality at the Austin, Miami and Berlin E-Prix, driver and engineering access for Infineon's customer events and PCIM-week activations.
value.label: What the team gives back

why_now.text: On 6 May 2026 Infineon raised its fiscal 2026 guidance: revenue now expected to grow significantly, a segment result margin of about 20%, adjusted free cash flow of about EUR 1.65B (from EUR 1.4B), with AI data-centre revenue expected at about EUR 1.5B this fiscal year and about EUR 2.5B next. On 8 June it announced with Siemens that its silicon-carbide power modules will be built into Siemens' semiconductor circuit breakers. The thin desk row called this a funding event; it is a peak-demand moment at a public incumbent, which is inside 1440's profile.
why_now.label: Trigger

why_now.text: Infineon is telling the market that its power semiconductors sit at the centre of two build-outs at once: the AI data centre and the electric drivetrain. A company reframing itself from 'chip supplier' to 'the power behind electrification' needs a stage where that story is visible, and Formula E is the only championship whose whole product is the inverter.
why_now.label: Peak demand meets a new identity

why_now.text: GEN4 debuts at the Jeddah E-Prix on 18-19 December 2026 with 600 kW, permanent all-wheel drive, a 55 kWh battery and up to 700 kW of regeneration. Season 13 partner rosters close in the autumn. A partner agreed before the London E-Prix in August is on the car for the first race of a four-season era.
why_now.label: The GEN4 window

why_now.text: Season 13 visits Austin on 6 February 2027 and Miami on 20 February 2027, in the market where Infineon's Americas headquarters (Milpitas) and Austin site sit, and returns to Berlin in May, the home race for a Munich-area company.
why_now.label: Calendar and markets

why_team.text: Jaguar TCS Racing's roster in the sponsor table is TCS (title and technology), Castrol and Jaguar's own powertrain; the 2025/26 livery release adds Dow, Reflo, Alpinestars and Chase. No semiconductor or electronics brand. The team ran a US silicon-carbide supplier as Official Power Semiconductor Partner from 2023; that company went through Chapter 11 in 2025 and is not named on the current roster.
why_team.label: The open lane

why_team.text: Jaguar first used silicon carbide in its Formula E inverter in 2017 and has spoken about it publicly ever since. Selling Infineon into Jaguar is not an education job: the engineers already know what the technology is worth in efficiency and lap time.
why_team.label: The team that proved the material

why_team.text: Jaguar TCS Racing has signed for the GEN4 era, Seasons 13 to 16, from 2026. A three-season partnership sits entirely inside a period the team has already committed to, with a road-car parent (JLR) whose next electric models are the transfer story.
why_team.label: Committed for the whole era

why_team.text: The electronic-components cluster at DS Penske (Mouser Electronics, TTI, Molex, KYOCERA AVX) makes that team a distributor showcase rather than a semiconductor lane; the works teams Porsche and Nissan carry only their parent brands and their own supplier relationships. Jaguar is the one team where a power-semiconductor partner has a precedent and an empty seat.
why_team.label: Where the rivals are

ruled_out.reason: Mouser Electronics, TTI, Molex and KYOCERA AVX hold the electronic-components lane; a distributor cluster, not a home for a chipmaker.

ruled_out.team: Porsche Formula E Team · Nissan Formula E Team
ruled_out.reason: Works teams carrying only the parent brand; inverter supply sits inside the manufacturer's own procurement, not a partner slot.
TWG AI is primary partner and Nissan supplies the powertrain from Season 13; the technology story is already taken.
Open but not chosen: Tech Mahindra and Sand Technologies occupy the technology lanes; neither has the silicon-carbide precedent.

ruled_out.team: Cupra Kiro · Lola Yamaha ABT Formula E Team · Citroën Racing
ruled_out.reason: Open but not chosen: customer or first-season programmes with smaller platforms; no power-electronics heritage to build on.
The story is EV-native; the F1 semiconductor lanes are held by ARM (Aston Martin Aramco), Arrow Electronics (McLaren) and AMD and Snapdragon (Mercedes).

brief_data.bottom_line: A EUR 14.7B power-semiconductor leader at peak demand, a board-level CMO, and the one Formula E team that has run a power-semiconductor partner now without one, five months before a 600 kW car arrives. Warm rather than hot: no capital event, but the lane and the calendar line up.

brief_data.the_case_p1: On 6 May 2026 Infineon reported second-quarter revenue of EUR 3.81B, up 6%, and raised fiscal 2026 guidance: revenue growing significantly, a segment result margin of about 20% and adjusted free cash flow of about EUR 1.65B, up from EUR 1.4B. AI data-centre revenue is expected at about EUR 1.5B this year and EUR 2.5B next. On 8 June it announced with Siemens that its silicon-carbide modules will sit inside Siemens' semiconductor circuit breakers. This is a EUR 14.7B, 57,000-person company at a demand peak, with a board-level chief marketing officer.
brief_data.the_case_p2: Silicon carbide lets an inverter switch faster and waste less, which in an electric race car is range and lap time. Jaguar first ran it in 2017 and made its US supplier Official Power Semiconductor Partner in 2023; that supplier went through Chapter 11 last year and is absent from the 2025/26 roster. GEN4 arrives in December with 600 kW, permanent all-wheel drive and 700 kW regeneration: the series' biggest power-electronics step.

brief_data.value_content: MODE A - operational. GEN4 doubles the electrical workload: 600 kW across two motors, 700 kW regeneration, permanent all-wheel drive. Infineon supplies CoolSiC power modules and gate drivers for the traction inverters, application engineering on switching losses and cooling, and silicon carbide for the pit equipment. In return: Official Power Semiconductor Partner, inverter-cover and halo branding, Austin and Miami hospitality for Infineon's automotive and data-centre customers.
brief_data.why_team_para: Jaguar TCS Racing carries TCS as title and technology partner, Castrol on fluids and Jaguar's own powertrain. There is no semiconductor or electronics brand on the roster. It is the team that proved silicon carbide in Formula E, has signed for the GEN4 era through Season 16, and whose parent JLR sells the road cars the technology transfers into. For a German company with an Americas base in California, a British works team racing in Austin and Miami is the stage.
brief_data.deal_arch_para: Entry as Official Power Semiconductor Partner. <font name='Poppins-Bold' size='9.5'>THREE YEARS</font>, Seasons 13-15 (2026-2029), inside the GEN4 era. Estimated EUR 3-5M a year, part in components and engineering. Scope: inverter modules and support, halo and rear-wing branding, Austin, Miami and Berlin hospitality, technical content.
brief_data.why_now_callout: <font name='Poppins-Bold' size='9'>WHY NOW</font>  GEN4 debuts at the Jeddah E-Prix on 18-19 December 2026, the first season of a four-season era Jaguar has signed for. Season 13 partner rosters close in the autumn; a partner agreed before the London E-Prix in August is on the car for the first 600 kW race.
brief_data.decision_maker_bio: Urschitz has sat on the Management Board as Chief Marketing Officer since 2022, with a mandate to 2030; brand and sponsorship are his call. Path: Jochen Hanebeck, CEO since 2022, and Sven Schneider, CFO since 2019. Infineon last bought motorsport with the Infineon Raceway naming rights, 2002-2012.
brief_data.decision_maker_role: Chief Marketing Officer, Member of the Management Board, Infineon
brief_data.opening_angle_quote: “Andreas, Jaguar proved silicon carbide in Formula E and its power-semiconductor partner has gone. GEN4 is a 600 kW car in December and Infineon is number one in the material. 25 minutes before London to see the numbers?”
